about_the_game:
Infidelity!? Is that truly acceptable?

While there's genuine attraction toward 'him', such betrayal! Completely unacceptable!?

Additional Info

Currently posting some development updates on my personal Rednote account: ID「睡觉」

Will create an official account for unified inquiries and promotions when preparations are more complete.

This DEMO includes:

  • Common route prologue + Chapter 1 (approx. 1-2 hours gameplay)

  • DEMO content doesn't affect subsequent plots and doesn't include late-game cheating routes

  • DEMO accounts for ~25% of full game, no affection routes/personal routes included

  • Fully voiced dialogue + 4 initial encounter CGs

(Due to heavy workload and lengthy production time, CV credits will be announced after DEMO release + completion of full script)

Synopsis
(*All locations are fictional)

Protagonist "Kariya" (*surname only - given name customizable)

transfers to Tokyo's Tsukiyo High School due to parents' job relocation. To fulfill childhood friend's desire to write romance novels, helps collect material at school. Gradually grows closer to "research subjects" through various interactions...

...However, shortly after starting a relationship, realizes fading affection for current partner while developing feelings for someone else. Will you stay loyal through the relationship's rocky phase, or succumb to temptation in this increasingly twisted love triangle?

Character Introduction

Oniyanagi Itsuki

  • Shy underclassman with delicate features often praised as "beautiful"

  • Troubled by feminine appearance, actively seeks ways to appear more masculine

  • Forms band with Yuukari and Saotome (main drummer, occasional bassist)

Next character:
【Saotome Haruhi】(Unlocks in May^^)

About the Game

Sudden inspiration to create otome game using my OCs. Despite title "Cheating Absolutely Forbidden", initial routes follow standard otome romance patterns.

  • 4 main + 4 secondary romanceable characters

  • Secondary routes intricately connected to main routes

  • Romantic routes can get quite messy

*Current profiles show basic info only - full versions require in-game interactions
(PS: Incomplete endings await unfaithful players)

Credits

Backgrounds:
Unsplash photographers: Nguyễn Hiệp, Luis Gherasim, JAWZ, Jacob Hodgson, Carlos Coronado, Alan Alves, Piya Kirdpanya, Max, Techivation

Icons:
Flaticon creators: th studio, Pixel perfect, Freepik

3D Models:
Fab artist: Rafael Rodrigues

BGM/CV credits to be fully listed after completion. Some purchased assets temporarily categorized here for organizational purposes. Sincere gratitude to all contributors - saved tremendous resources TT
